patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports the recent appearance of several brown, greasy, seemingly superficial lesions on his forehead. He mentions they appeared a few weeks ago and has not noticed any recent changes in size or color. He attempted to scrape them off, assuming they were dirt or a smear, but they persisted. No itching or pain is associated with the lesions.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Hypertension, controlled with medication. No history of skin cancer or chronic skin diseases.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Retired school teacher. Non-smoker. Enjoys gardening and spends time outdoors.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies weight loss, fever, night sweats, or any recent illnesses.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with skin lesions on the forehead.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’m a 77-year-old man and I’ve noticed several brown, greasy-looking spots on my forehead that started a few weeks ago. I tried scraping them off, thinking they were dirt or a smear, but they didn’t come away and I haven’t had any itching or pain.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like areas where the skin is scratched, rubbed raw, or has small open spots—anywhere on your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any scratched, rubbed-raw, or open spots anywhere on my body.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you suddenly wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any episodes like stopping breathing or suddenly waking up gasping for air during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No—since I didn’t have any injury, I haven’t had severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using any area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared with the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist, and the skin there looks similar to the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the skin of your chest), especially after an injury or coughing?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising or dark/discolored areas on my chest wall, and I don’t recall any injury or significant coughing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine than normal?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t been urinating much more than usual or noticed needing to go more often, and my urine amount seems about the same.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t use tobacco or cannabis, and I’m not using opioids or stimulants—just my prescribed medication for hypertension.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had trouble controlling my urine, and I don’t have leaking or urgency where I can’t make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any nosebleeds or any blood coming from my nose recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk, chest, back, or belly anywhere.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or ankles?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs around the calves or ankles.”
